tiktok_extra.heading: Call
tiktok_extra.narration: Big balance at a high rate? A quick call asking for a lower APR sometimes works, especially if you've always paid on time.

tiktok_extra.heading: Minimums
tiktok_extra.narration: Always pay at least the minimum on everything, so a late fee doesn't add to the problem.
tiktok_extra.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a calendar with a check mark. No text, no logos, no real people.

tiktok_extra.heading: Plan
tiktok_extra.narration: Divide the total by the months you want to be done in. That's your monthly payoff number.
tiktok_extra.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a big division sign. No text, no logos, no real people.

tiktok_extra.heading: Talk

idea_angle: Explainer: how to prepare for the January credit card statement after the holidays.

script.title: January statement shock: a 3-step plan
script.hook: The holiday credit card statement lands in January. A 3-step plan before it does.

segments.heading: Hook
segments.narration: The holiday credit card statement lands in January. Here's a 3-step plan before it does.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. the small round green piggy bank mascot with big eyes an envelope with a card. No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.narration: Log in now and see the balance so far. The statement number won't be a surprise.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a laptop with a card. No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.narration: Find the statement due date and set a reminder three days before.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a calendar with a bell. No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.narration: Pay the full statement balance if you can. That's the amount that avoids interest on most cards.
segments.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a coin going to a card. No text, no logos, no real people.

script.cta: Follow for one money move a week.
script.caption:
January statement plan:
1. Check your balance now
2. Note the due date; set a reminder 3 days early
3. Pay the full statement balance if you can, which avoids interest on most cards

Can't pay it all? Pay as much as you can, at least the minimum, and make a payoff plan.

Follow for one money move a week.
script.description: A three-step plan before the January credit card statement.
claims_to_verify: Grace period applies when paid in full on most cards

tiktok_extra.heading: Can't pay all
tiktok_extra.narration: Can't pay it all? Pay as much as you can above the minimum. Interest is charged on what's left.
tiktok_extra.on_screen_text: Pay as much as you can
tiktok_extra.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a coin stack being split. No text, no logos, no real people.

tiktok_extra.heading: Autopay
tiktok_extra.narration: Set autopay for at least the minimum, so a busy January doesn't cause a late fee.
tiktok_extra.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a small gear and a card. No text, no logos, no real people.

tiktok_extra.heading: Freeze
tiktok_extra.narration: Then do a no-spend week in early January to give your budget room to catch up.
tiktok_extra.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a padlock over a bag. No text, no logos, no real people.

tiktok_extra.heading: Plan
tiktok_extra.narration: Divide whatever's left by three months, and make that your payoff target.
tiktok_extra.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a calendar with three jars. No text, no logos, no real people.

tiktok_extra.heading: Balance transfer
tiktok_extra.narration: Big balance at a high rate? A balance transfer card can help, but only if the fee is smaller than the interest and you can pay it off before the promo ends.
tiktok_extra.on_screen_text: Transfer only if the math works
tiktok_extra.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. two cards with an arrow. No text, no logos, no real people.

tiktok_extra.heading: Pay later
tiktok_extra.narration: Used pay-later plans too? Add those dates next to the card due date, so January has no surprises.
tiktok_extra.visual_prompt: Warm flat vector illustration, muted greens and cream with a mustard accent, simple shapes. a calendar with small cards. No text, no logos, no real people.
